name: Knowify
description: Knowify lets agents read jobs, clients, estimates, invoices, and time entries in the signed-in Knowify account. Each user signs in to their own Knowify account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my active jobs and how much of each budget is used.
Which invoices are past due, and for which clients?
Draft an estimate for a bathroom remodel from these notes.

apps.name: Knowify
apps.description: Jobs, clients, estimates, and invoices, over Knowify's MCP server with browser sign-in.
